name: prompt-quality-monitor
description: Prompt Quality Monitor — score your own Claude Code prompts against the CHI '26 vibe-coding rubric.

plugins.name: prompt-quality-monitor
plugins.description: Extracts the prompts you actually typed from your Claude Code session logs, classifies each turn, scores the instruction turns on specificity, structure and constraints, optionally grades a sample with the paper's expert rubric, and reports which habits track with rework.
